*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[2019–20 Western Libya campaign]]
***The [[Government of National Accord]] (GNA) says its forces have taken full control of [[Bani Walid]], including [[Bani Walid Airport]], and [[Al ‘Urban]] without facing any resistance, as [[Libyan National Army]] forces abandon their positions. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/inbrief/libyan-army-takes-full-control-bani-walid-and-urban-without-battle (''The Libya Observer'')]
***GNA forces state that they have discovered 160 bodies in and around a hospital in the recently captured [[Tarhuna]], including the bodies of women and young children, which the GNA Ministry of Health remark appear to have only recently been killed. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/inbrief/160-bodies-found-and-around-tarhuna-hospital (''The Libya Observer'')]
***GNA forces say they have begun a military operation to recapture the coastal city of [[Sirte]] from pro-[[Khalifa Haftar|Haftar]] forces. [https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/libyan-army-launches-military-operation-to-liberate-sirte/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***Egyptian President [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] says [[Khalifa Haftar]] supports a ceasefire starting Monday, June 8, with the condition that all "foreign mercenaries leave Libyan territory". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/egypt-el-sisi-haftar-backs-libya-ceasefire-200606133939141.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Kaohsiung mayoral recall vote]]
**Incumbent mayor of [[Kaohsiung]] and former [[2020 Taiwanese presidential election|presidential candidate]] [[Han Kuo-yu]] is removed from office after 939,090 people voted for his recall, vastly exceeding the minimum threshold of 574,996 votes. This marks the first time a mayor has been successfully recalled in [[Taiwan]]. [https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202006060016 (Central News Agency)]
